quests.name: A Parcel for the Food Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Selendale to the food shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the food shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the banker.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Archery Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the archery shop keeper of Selendale and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the archery shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The general store keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Selendale Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Selendale Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Selendale Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Zombies
quests.summary: The sword shop keeper wants the zombie near Selendale thinned out.
intro: The zombie beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 11 of them close to Selendale and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Logs
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper of Selendale has run out of logs.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 18 logs and nobody in Selendale has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Barber
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Selendale to the barber.
intro: This should have gone to the barber days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the magic shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Selendale and bring back raw tuna.
intro: The wilds around Selendale need a firm hand. Start with 11 giant rat outside the walls, then 18 giant spider down in Selendale Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 18 raw tuna to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Selendale for the general store keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the sword shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The general store keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the barber does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the sword shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Selendale Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant spider out of Selendale Sewers and tell the armour shop keeper.
intro: Selendale Sewers is crawling with giant spider, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 18 of them, then let the armour shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Selendale owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Selendale Sewers is clearer than it was. 18 giant spider fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Lorowick
quests.summary: Gather coal for the sword shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Lorowick.
intro: I have an order from Lorowick and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 22 coal, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the sword shop keeper in Selendale.
From Selendale? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

Bring me 18 raw trout, then take the packed shipment to the food shop keeper there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the food shop keeper in Selendale.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Selendale
quests.summary: Find what rules Selendale Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Rat King.
intro: Something rules Selendale Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the clothes shop keeper what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Selendale is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Rat King.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Rat King is dead. Selendale Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Cinder Maw, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Cinder Maw has stood against Selendale for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the staff shop keeper, fight your way through 26 cave goblin and end The Broodmother.
Bring 13 big bones back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Cinder Maw?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Selendale: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Selendale Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Selendale and Lorowick.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Lorowick. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 26 zombie near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the clothes shop keeper underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the banker in Selendale.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Lorowick is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Selendale has not had news this good in years.
